text:
sam: Quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem — we must assign owners and deadlines for the test/eval work so it doesn't stall. I propose three deliverables: (1) regression scenario pack, (2) eviction-edge prompt bank + metadata, (3) soak + micro-chaos runbook. Who takes what?
ani: I can do the prompt bank. Will curate ~180 prompts (short/long prefixes, truncation, aliasing) with seeds and expected behavior. Target: 8 days.
reza: I'll build the regression scenario pack and runner. Plan: 30 scenario families, deterministic seeds, small presubmit subset + nightly sampled matrix. ETA: 12 days.
claire: Ops will own the soak + micro-chaos execution and runbook (prechecks, rollback, metrics). I'll schedule a dry run in staging next week.
sam: Good — add clear pass/fail criteria. For the soak: 30m at 1.1x prod 99th, synthetic 10s spike; success if fallback <1%, 95p latency increase <25%, KV miss spike <4x baseline.
claire: Noted. We'll dashboard those signals and capture post-run artifacts.
ani: I'll tag prompts by sensitivity level and model/quantization variants so CI sampling is efficient. High-sensitivity prompts run weekly, low for nightly.
reza: For CI, we'll do small+med nightly, full sweep weekly. Add a presubmit gating job for PRs touching KV/cache/router paths that runs the tiny scenario subset. Example matchers: "src/serving/kv/**", "libs/cache/**", "src/router/**".
sam: Ops-bot — please create tracker issues and add recurrences: weekly regression maintenance (reza) and quarterly chaos runs (claire). Link back to the postmortem.
ops-bot: Created tasks: MK-900 (prompt bank) owner: ani due: 2026-04-11; MK-901 (regression pack) owner: rezA due: 2026-04-15; MK-902 (soak+runbook) owner: claire due: 2026-04-10. Recurrences: weekly regression review (reza) and quarterly chaos execution (claire). Links: https://tasks.internal/MK-900 https://tasks.internal/MK-901 https://tasks.internal/MK-902
reza: I'll include cost caps and a fail-open annotation for infra flakiness. Presubmit will be quick (<2m) runner.
ani: I'll upload a CSV/spreadsheet with prompt metadata and expected outputs to MK-900 and @-mention ML reviewers.
claire: Dry run scheduled Wed 2026-04-01 09:00 PT in staging. Invites sent.
sam: Thanks folks. After the dry run we'll reconvene to confirm thresholds and finalize the recurrence cadence. :white_check_mark:
